home.title: Learn Docker and DevOps from scratch
home.intro: No prior knowledge needed. Every new word is explained before it is used, and every lesson ends with hands-on missions that the site checks for you.

fromZero.title: Truly from zero
fromZero.text: We start with what an operating system is and how to use the terminal, then move on to Docker, pipelines and production.

missions.title: Checked missions
missions.text: Quizzes, a simulated terminal, files to write and labs on real Docker. Every answer gets feedback explaining what works and what is missing.

local.title: Your progress stays yours
local.text: No account and no server: everything is saved only in this browser. You can export your progress to a file and pick it up elsewhere.

map.title: Course map
map.intro: The course is divided into worlds. Each world contains levels to complete in order and ends with a final challenge.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address you opened does not match any page of the course.

footer.storage: Progress is saved only in this browser.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.maxRank: You have reached the highest rank. Congratulations!

senza-aiuti.name: Inner compass
senza-aiuti.description: Pass a mission without using hints.

perseverante.name: Persistent
perseverante.description: Pass a mission after at least 5 attempts: making mistakes is part of learning.

serie-7.name: Week on fire
serie-7.description: Study for 7 days in a row.

backup.title: Saving your progress
backup.intro: Progress is saved only in this browser. Export it to a file to keep a backup or to continue on another device.
backup.storageUnavailable: This browser does not allow saving data (for example in private browsing): your progress will be lost when you close it. Export it before leaving.
backup.confirmImport: The file contains {{lessons}} lessons read and {{missions}} missions passed. Replace your current progress with it?
backup.confirmReset: All progress, XP and badges will be deleted from this browser. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalidJson: The file cannot be read: it does not contain JSON data.
errors.wrongFile: This file is not a progress export from this course.
errors.invalidData: The file is damaged: the progress inside it is not valid.
errors.newerVersion: The file was created with a newer version of the course. Reload the page and try again.
errors.readFailed: The file could not be read.

level.lockedText: This level unlocks when you complete the previous one. Every level uses words and ideas explained in the levels before it: skipping them would make everything harder.
level.comingSoonText: The lessons for this level are still being written. It will become available as soon as they are ready.

sources.title: Learn more in the official documentation
sources.verified: Content checked against the official documentation on {{date}}.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Every technical word in the course, explained simply. Each entry links to the lesson that introduces it.
glossary.empty: The glossary fills up as lessons are published.
